text:
kelsey: quick sync: we need a compact, privacy-safe metrics surface for the on-prem/VPC export agent. goal is per-tenant health + backlog + encryption/audit visibility in Console. starting list + open questions below.
rafael: sounds good. pls enumerate metric names and labels. we must avoid PII — tenant id needs to be hashed. also add tenant_tier label.
june: firewall note: most customers will only open outbound 443. provide SNI hostnames and a small IP set for allowlists. fallback path should use VPC endpoint options.
mina: runtime: agent exposes Prometheus metrics locally and can push via mTLS. we should standardize metric names and histogram buckets. implement cardinality controls.
oliver: heads up: telemetry ingest affects quota/billing and storage. product must decide opt-in vs default for private installs.
kelsey: PROPOSED METRICS (naming + type + labels):
- export_agent_send_total (counter) — labels: tenant_hash, tenant_tier, region, agent_version, dest_type
- export_agent_send_failures_total (counter) — labels: tenant_hash, error_class, http_status
- export_agent_queue_depth (gauge) — labels: tenant_hash, queue_name
- export_agent_batch_items_histogram (histogram) — labels: tenant_hash, dest_type; buckets on 1,4,8,16,32,64
- export_agent_kms_encrypt_failures_total (counter) — labels: tenant_hash, kms_provider
- export_agent_audit_delivery_latency_seconds (histogram) — labels: tenant_hash; buckets: 0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5,1,2
- export_agent_last_seen_unix (gauge) — labels: tenant_hash
- export_agent_payload_bytes (histogram) — labels: tenant_hash, dest_type
mina: also expose kv_cache_hit_ratio and forwarding_retries_total with identical name patterns so dashboards can reuse existing panels.
rafael: add route_id label where useful but cap unique routes per tenant to 50. otherwise cardinality explodes.
june: EGRESS QUICKSTART (for firewall rules):
- SNI: collector.redwood-internal.net (SNI required)
- TLS port: 443 outbound
- IP allowlist examples: 34.120.16.0/24, 34.120.17.0/24
- auth: mTLS preferred (client cert); fallback: JWT bearer token if mTLS not available
kelsey: sample push payload (agent -> collector) — redact any user data in metrics; only hashed tenant id in labels.
```json
{
  "tenant_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "metrics": [ { "name": "export_agent_send_total", "value": 1, "labels": { "dest_type": "s3" } } ],
  "envelope": "base64(...)",
  "kms_key_id": "opaque-id"
}
```
mina: on runtime we'll include a per-tenant cardinality cap and sample high-cardinality routes into an opt-in stream.
oliver: Console UX ask: per-tenant panel with three tiles: HEALTH (success vs failure rate + last_seen), BACKLOG (queue_depth + backlog estimate), SECURITY (kms failures + audit delivery latency). allow filter by route_id and quick time windows. surface top-5 failing tenants.
rafael: dashboard impl note: we cannot backfill historic data before agents adopt the new schema. show migration banner and include rollout state.
kelsey: rollout suggestion: new installers enable telemetry by default but require explicit consent during setup for Private. existing installs default off. enable a per-tenant canary toggle for first 10 tenants.
security-bot: reminder: any telemetry leaving customer network must be documented and opt-in recorded for Private. see intra doc: https://intra/docs/onprem-telemetry-policy
june: proposed handshake / KMS flow: 1) agent encrypts payload envelope with data key; data key encrypted with customer KMS or server KMS as configured. 2) attach kms_key_id (opaque) as metric label. 3) collector returns ack with audit_id which agent posts to customer audit hook. we need metrics: ack_failures_total and audit_hook_delivery_success_total.
rafael: UX migration checklist: show onboarding status per tenant, show last schema version observed, and link to upgrade instructions.
oliver: quota/billing: propose per-tenant metric cardinality cap + per-tenant telemetry ingest threshold. if threshold exceeded, sampling or rate-limited. will draft numbers.
kelsey: privacy checklist: never store prompt or content, only hashed tenant id and aggregated counters. redact any delivery receipts that contain user-visible fields.
june: i'll draft a 1-page "egress quickstart" with hostnames, IPs, cert thumbprints, and a minimal troubleshooting flow (blocked by corp FW).
mina: ACTIONS:
- mina: implement metric naming + cardinality cap + histogram buckets (due EOD Fri)
- june: draft egress quickstart + firewall allowlist + SNI hosts (due Wed)
- rafael: dashboard mockups + migration/canary UX copy (PR next Tue)
- oliver: quota & billing proposal (due next week)
- kelsey: update onboarding wording and opt-in flow (due Wed)
- security-bot: publish final privacy/redaction checklist (follow-up)
rafael: ok i'll post a proto dashboard in #design and we can review in sync tomorrow 10:00. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-notice: telemetry-collector will accept the new metric schema after maintenance window scheduled 2025-06-12 03:00 UTC.
